imported.excluded_dependency: UsageImpl#isVariable calls the mayTimeVary semantic service; a stored is_variable value cannot stand in for that getter.

generation: Resolved runtime method identities generate owning_type_featuring_supported; unknown or changed identities are excluded. All declaring sources and the runtime are pinned and hashed. This is bounded dispatch generation, not translation of the entire method body.
native_consumer: definition_materialize_owning_type_featuring uses generated admission and the shared handwritten owning-type/snapshot algorithm. Per-class algorithm patches are unnecessary.

verification.contexts: Fixed and variable features in controlled canonical FeatureMembership/Type contexts. These are class-dispatch controls, not grammar coverage for every class.
